title: INC-082: provider response deadline failures
body: Closed incident, 2026-08-04 10:10–10:52 UTC, eu-west-1. Payment failures followed provider-adapter dispatch; the provider acknowledged an upstream outage. Adapter response deadlines increased while checkout-api acquisition remained normal. Provider recovery ended the failures. Connection-pool tuning was considered and rejected. This incident is linked to RB-002, not a checkout-api release.
